instruction:
Edit `packages/excalidraw/tests/textStyleRanges.test.tsx` (unit U01) at these sites only, as its brief says, following the conventions in the shared brief:
- S1: replace line 2 (line 2 reads `import { newElementWith } from "@excalidraw/element";`) — Becomes the single line: import { CaptureUpdateAction, newElementWith } from "@excalidraw/element";
- S2: replace line 4 (line 4 reads `import type { ExcalidrawTextElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";`) — Becomes a multi-line `import type {` statement naming ExcalidrawTextElement then NonDeletedExcalidrawElement, one per line with trailing commas, closing with `} from "@excalidraw/element/types";`.
- S3: replace line 29 (line 29 reads `API.setSelectedElements([text]);`) — Becomes API.setSelectedElements([text as NonDeletedExcalidrawElement]); at the same two-space indent, nothing else changed.
- S4: replace line 66 (line 66 reads `API.setElements([text]);`) — Becomes the only seed call, at the same four-space indent, printed as prettier does: API.updateScene({ then `elements: [text],` and `captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY,` one per line, then });
- S5: replace line 172 (line 172 reads `Keyboard.undo();`) — At the same four-space indent, becomes in order: a two-line // comment saying the first undo reverts the selection-only appState entry Keyboard.exitTextEditor pushes and the second reverts the styleRanges update; Keyboard.undo(); Keyboard.undo(); expect(getText(text.id).isDeleted).toBe(false); the existing range assertion on lines 173-175 follows unchanged.
- S6: replace line 190 (line 190 reads `API.setSelectedElements([styled]);`) — Becomes API.setSelectedElements([styled as NonDeletedExcalidrawElement]); at the same four-space indent; line 194 (setSelectedElements([plain])) is not touched.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "packages/excalidraw/tests/textStyleRanges.test.tsx", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "packages/excalidraw/tests/textStyleRanges.test.tsx", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
